description: Hi, I am , an AI product builder blending psychology, HR, and information science. I've built Nurture AI, a postpartum support agent; SafeSpace Copilot, an Agents League-badged HR agent; and a co-op space game. I'm making a Mars outpost game where students balance life support, radiation, power, and food. Looking for a front-end/game developer, a UI designer, a space-science fact-checker, and an educator/writer. Join me!
summary: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a free browser game where students run a Mars or Moon outpost for 30 days. Players spend two crew hours a day balancing life support, radiation shielding, power and food. Every job helps one supply and costs another, so students feel the trade-offs that decide whether a real mission succeeds or fails. Events based on NASA science, such as dust storms, solar flares and lunar nights, add a real fact each time, and an end-of-mission debrief explains which trade-off mattered most.
